summary: The NL Scholarship, the new name for the Holland Scholarship, gives €5,000 in the first year to students from outside the EEA who start a full-time bachelor's or master's at one of 33 participating Dutch universities and universities of applied sciences. Applications for 2027-28 are open, and each institution sets its own deadline. It is not a full-tuition scholarship.
meta_description: The Holland Scholarship is now the NL Scholarship: €5,000 for non-EEA students at 33 Dutch institutions in 2027-28. Who can apply and how.
covers: €5,000, paid in the first year of your studies.
It is not a full-tuition scholarship, so the rest of the tuition fee and your living costs are yours to pay.
eligibility: A nationality from outside the European Economic Area (EEA).
An application for a full-time bachelor's or master's at one of the participating Dutch institutions.
Meeting the specific requirements of the institution you choose.
No degree from an education institution in the Netherlands.
how_to_apply: Choose a participating institution. Study in NL lists 33 for 2027-28, among them Radboud, Groningen, Twente, Utrecht, VU Amsterdam and Wageningen, and universities of applied sciences such as Fontys, Hanze and Saxion.
Apply for your programme at that institution.
Apply for the NL Scholarship as that institution's NL Scholarship page describes.
Meet the institution's own deadline for its 2027-28 rounds; Study in NL does not publish one date for all.
watch_out: Deadlines differ from one institution to the next, so check your institution's page as soon as you choose it.
The list of participating institutions changes every year.
You cannot get it if you already hold a Dutch degree.
costs: You, less the €5,000 in your first year
Living costs and the residence permit
documents: Your application for a full-time programme at a participating institution.
Whatever scholarship form or motivation the institution asks for on its NL Scholarship page.

faq.q: Is the Holland Scholarship still available?
faq.a: Yes, under a new name. Study in NL now calls it the NL Scholarship, and applications for 2027-28 are open.

faq.q: How much is the NL Scholarship?
faq.a: €5,000, paid in your first year. It is not a full-tuition scholarship.

faq.q: When is the NL Scholarship deadline?
faq.a: Each participating institution sets its own deadlines for its 2027-28 rounds, so check the page of the university you apply to.
